title: Pure Yummy
summary: Pure Yummy LIGHT Beast Synchro strategy, deploying miniature patisserie animal critters that swarm the field alongside their Link-1 star Yummy★Snatchy. The deck cycles Field Spells and unleashes mid-turn Synchro tagging to bounce enemy threats and recur materials.

summary.title: Starters
points: Yummy★Snatchy is a Link-1 monster summoned using any Level 1 Yummy that places a Yummy Field Spell (Yummyusment☆Mignon or Acroquey) face-up from your Deck on summon, and performs a Synchro Summon on either player's turn as a Quick Effect.
Cooky☆Yummy Special Summons itself from hand next to a Link-1 or Level 2 Synchro, and halves an enemy monster's ATK or destroys it if summoned by a Synchro Monster.
Lollipo☆Yummy Special Summons itself next to a Link-1 or Level 2 Synchro, and shuffles or banishes a card from the opponent's GY.
Marshmao☆Yummy Special Summons itself while you control no monsters or only LIGHT Beasts, and returns a Yummy Spell/Trap from GY or places a Yummy Field Spell from Deck.
Cupsy☆Yummy Special Summons itself on an empty or LIGHT Beast board, adding a Yummy card from Deck to hand or drawing 1 card.
Obedience Schooled Special Summons three different Level 1 LIGHT Beast monsters directly from your Deck with their effects negated, giving immediate material for Snatchy and Synchro plays.

summary.title: Opening: Obedience Schooled into Snatchy Tag
steps: Activate Obedience Schooled while controlling no monsters, Special Summoning Cooky☆Yummy, Lollipo☆Yummy, and Marshmao☆Yummy from your Deck.
Use Marshmao☆Yummy to Link Summon Yummy★Snatchy in the Extra Monster Zone.
Yummy★Snatchy triggers on summon to place Yummyusment☆Mignon face-up from your Deck.
Activate Yummyusment☆Mignon's effect to revive Marshmao☆Yummy from your GY next to Snatchy.
Synchro Summon Level 2 Cupsy★Yummy Way using Level 1 Tuner Snatchy and Level 1 Cooky☆Yummy; Cupsy Way triggers to search two Yummy monsters from Deck.
During the opponent's turn, tag out Cupsy Way to return it to the Extra Deck and revive two Yummy monsters from your GY.

summary.title: Bosses & Control: The Yummy Way Synchro Suite
points: Cupsy★Yummy Way is a Level 2 Synchro that searches two Yummy monsters on summon and returns to the Extra Deck during the opponent's turn to Special Summon two Yummy monsters from your GY.
Cooky★Yummy Way flips up to two monsters the opponent controls into face-down Defense Position upon summon, and tags out to revive two Yummys from GY.
Lollipo★Yummy Way revives two Yummy monsters from your GY upon summon, and tags out during the opponent's turn.
Martial Metal Marcher and Shamisen Samsara Sorrowcat provide Level 3 Synchro Tuner extension, reviving Tuners and enabling Accel Synchro plays during the opponent's Main Phase.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Yummyusment☆Mignon boosts all Yummy monsters' ATK and revives a Level 1 Yummy monster from GY each turn.
Yummyusment★Acroquey destroys a card on the field whenever you Synchro Summon a LIGHT Beast, and replaces your field if the opponent removes your monsters.
Assist★Yummy! sends two Yummy cards from hand or field to the GY to return a card on the field or in either GY to the hand, and mills a Yummy card from Deck from the GY.
Yummy☆Surprise bounces two opponent cards while returning two of your own, revives a Yummy, or swaps your active Field Spell.
Yummy★Redemption reduces enemy ATK, draws cards on LIGHT Beast Synchro Summons, and swaps control of monsters from the GY.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Herald of the Arc Light is Forbidden and Sky Striker/Mitsurugi hybrid engines are omitted to focus on a dedicated, pure Yummy beast strategy.

exclude.Herald of the Arc Light: Forbidden in the TCG; the page's older lines still use it.
